description: Search saved notes and return the best matches as short previews with ids (default 20, at most 200). mode: keyword = the words you give, semantic = similar meaning (falls back to keyword if embeddings are off), hybrid = both, relevant = pass the user's whole message as query (do not combine it with when or include_replaced: that returns an error). Narrow with when, written_by, not_written_by. Replaced notes are hidden unless include_replaced=true. Read-only.

detail.description: "full": every field and up to 600 body characters per note.

include_replaced.description: Also return notes that a newer note has replaced.

mode.description: How to match; see the tool description.

not_written_by.description: Leave out notes written by this writer.

query.description: What to look for: words, a question, or (mode relevant) a whole message.

written_by.description: Only notes written by this writer.

name: memory_search
title: Search notes
